objective: Make supervised movement and camera control responsive and independent of V1 source, while preserving bounded input, exact identity and honest response evidence.

evidence.supports: Current runtime imports V1 modules, permits only single W/A/S/D pulses and repeatedly captures/reconnects.
evidence.limitations: Does not establish that all latency comes from VNC.

evidence.supports: S/A/D delivery, release and coarse API/visual response worked.
evidence.limitations: No numerical heading, camera or responsiveness qualification.

evidence.supports: Standard RFB pointer events carry absolute positions.
evidence.limitations: Does not rule out vendor extensions.

evidence.supports: SendInput inserts keyboard/mouse events; UIPI constrains permitted integrity levels.
evidence.limitations: Insertion is not proof that RIFT responds.

evidence.supports: Relative motion and wheel events are supported; Windows acceleration can affect motion.
A browser control surface can collect relative deltas without screen-edge constraints.
evidence.limitations: Requires user gesture and browser support.

evidence.locator: commit as needed, when ready produce optimal roadmap then follow it to completion
evidence.supports: Authorizes implementation and verification after the proposal, superseding design-only restrictions.
evidence.limitations: No autonomous gameplay, process writes/injection, V1 changes or incidental global configuration changes.

findings.claim: V1 runtime imports and per-pulse setup make the current path unsuitable as the native interactive interface.
findings.impact: Replace the control path; keep historical evidence.

findings.claim: Guest-local scan codes and relative mouse input are a better fit for movement/camera than absolute host pointer control.
findings.impact: Validate real game behavior before claiming camera readiness.

findings.claim: Numeric heading/pitch/zoom and hard-crash key-state recovery remain unqualified.
findings.impact: Separate transport acknowledgements, visual observations and future semantic measurements.

options.movementSupport: Keyboard chords possible; host owns timing and release.
options.cameraSupport: Standard absolute pointer path; relative game camera behavior uncertain.
options.rationale: Useful bootstrap and screenshot fallback, not the primary camera path.

options.approach: Guest-local .NET input agent with outbound authenticated persistent connection and loopback host UI
prerequisites: Same or greater integrity as RIFT
options.movementSupport: Scan-code chords with guest-local bounded timing, cancellation and durable release intent.
options.cameraSupport: Relative mouse, left/right drag and wheel; Pointer Lock operator surface.
options.rationale: Moves timing and release checks next to the game while avoiding guest inbound listeners and new services.

options.approach: Host SendInput into VMware console window
prerequisites: Host console focus and stable geometry
options.cameraSupport: Two pointer-capture layers and uncertain relative behavior.
options.rationale: Weaker target binding and more geometry dependence than guest-local input.

components: Application bounded executor and input port
Live Windows adapter and control-agent command
Python standard-library host hub and static operator panel
inputLifecycle: Arm a short session bound to target and geometry
Validate one sequenced action and persist release intent
Execute locally with frequent target/cancellation checks
Release every intended input in finally
Record outcome and retain failed-release intent
Disarm on stop, disconnect, expiry or failure

feedbackContract.inputIntent: Host request plus guest action record
feedbackContract.release: Attempt and success per input, not game key-state attestation
feedbackContract.visual: Fresh frame before/after; screenshot backend must be visually validated
feedbackContract.addon: Existing RR2 live path remains an independent optional source

failureHandling: Reject stale/replayed commands and changed target/geometry
Never queue or retry ambiguous actions
Stop can cancel an active action without waiting for its normal duration
Restart disarmed; recover retained release intent only for the same exact target
Never claim cleanup after OS/agent hard failure without evidence
v1DependencyMigration: Use its credential derivation only as a documented existing-VM compatibility detail
Deploy a self-contained RR2 Live bundle
Replace the legacy host receiver on its existing allowed port for this task
Remove V1 imports from the recommended runtime path; retain old experiment adapter as explicitly legacy evidence tooling

operatorInterface.controls: Reviewed arm, movement keys/chords, relative camera drag, wheel, stop/recover
operatorInterface.deadman: Finite actions and arm expiry; blur and Pointer Lock loss stop
operatorInterface.state: Target identity, foreground, pending recovery, result and errors

phases.outcome: Native bounded execution and Windows adapters

acceptanceTests.behavior: Invalid/stale input never executes; all partial-send paths release intended inputs

phases.outcome: Native host/guest connection and usable operator controls

acceptanceTests.behavior: Unauthorized/replayed/busy requests rejected; stop and disconnect cancel; UI cannot continue unattended
acceptanceTests.method: Protocol regression tests and UI inspection

phases.outcome: Bounded live movement/camera and recovery evidence
changes: Deploy exact published bundle without VM configuration changes
Individually review movement/chord/strafe, orbit/mouse-look, pitch and wheel actions

acceptanceTests.behavior: Movement and camera commands produce attributable visible changes
acceptanceTests.method: Individual reviewed trials with before/after frames
acceptanceTests.proposedTarget: Record each supported behavior or explicit limitation

acceptanceTests.behavior: Local timing and stop remain bounded
acceptanceTests.method: Guest monotonic timings and host round trips
acceptanceTests.metric: Hold error and stop acknowledgement milliseconds
acceptanceTests.proposedTarget: Hold error <=20 ms; connected stop acknowledgement <=250 ms

phases.outcome: Verified native workflow, durable roadmap and coherent commits

acceptanceTests.behavior: Recommended runtime works without original RiftReader source
acceptanceTests.method: Import/path audit and live native-agent operation

assumptions: The selected game runs in the logged-in interactive guest session.
The existing private receiver port can be reused; no firewall changes are incidental.
Guest GDI capture is provisional for this windowed client; black/incorrect captures block review and require VNC fallback.
openQuestions: How RIFT interprets left/right relative drag, pitch and wheel in this session.
Measured control responsiveness and synthetic input acceptance.
Whether future numerical camera feedback is available through supported API.
nextAction: Implement P01 and P02, then perform individually reviewed bounded P03 trials and finish P04.
